events.title: Major Game Update!
events.summary: Greetings fellow broke wizards! We've been heads down for longer than we wanted, but have been hard at work on some exciting updates!We’ve listened to feedback and completely overhauled the Job Meta to be competitive focused. So now every job you take matters toward the goal of topping the leaderboards at the end of the week! Jobs are started by accessing WizDash kiosks all over the neighborhood. events.title: Demo Hotfix 2
events.summary: Added Launcher on startup for DX11, DX12 and Vulkan. This should help users having performance issues on lower end PCs.Fixed bug where the game wasn't correctly detecting audio input for some users automatically.Fixed controller bug where user was unable to changed inverted controls. (please note we do not officially support controller yet, but the game is playable with a controller in most places)Adjusted timers for Non Combat Jobs.

events.title: Demo Hotfix 1
events.summary: Several fixes for improving reliability when trying to connect to a game. Fixed a player stacking UI bug,Lowered volume on job reminder SFX.
